end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified ten and four loose sticks in separate prompts.
The 1 in 15/16 was repeatedly treated as one stick rather than one ten.
Teach-back was not passed; no unaided answers were correct in one attempt.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a bundle of ten plus loose sticks and asked Saanvi to explain what the digits show. Saanvi engaged with examples such as 16 and 15 and identified loose ones in some prompts. The mix-up that the 1 means only one stick was still present at the end, so it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, make a bundle of 10 straws and add loose straws for numbers 11–20, asking, “How many tens and how many ones?”
